title: Ayyohan Naas Shumara
body:
Ya Aba Abdillah, Ya Sarallah, Aaah Ya Hussain !
Ayyuhan-Naas Shumara Ba Haqqey Khun-e-Hussain
Najjayi dosh Numaya Idani Shewan-o-Shayn
Jab Talak Saans Chaley Matam-e-Shabbir Chaley
Sath Qur'an Key Jis Tarha Key Tafsseer Chaley
Maqsadey Khilkat-e-Insaan Hai Gham-e-Shah Mei Bayn Najjayi Dosh...
Haq Hai Meraj-e-Ibadaat bhi Yehi Matam Hai
Har Ibadaat Ki Zamanat Bhi Yehi Matam hai
Maqsadey Khilkat-e-Insaan Hai Gham-e-Shah Mei Bayn Najjayi Dosh...
Gham-e-Shabbir Ko Sinon Sey Lagey Rakha
Issi Matam Ney Zameeron Ko Jagaey Rakha
Maqsadey Khilkat-e-Insaan Hai Gham-e-Shah Mei Bayn Najjayi Dosh...
Zulm Ko Lashkar-e-Mazloom Ney Jo Mara Hai
Thap Matam Ki Usi Fath-ha Ka Naqqara Hai
Maqsadey Khilkat-e-Insaan Hai Gham-e-Shah Mei Bayn Najjayi Dosh...
Bakhsh Kar Deen Ko Tabeenda Jawani Tuney
Pyass Sey Pher Diya Kufr Pey Paani Tuney
Maqsadey Khilkat-e-Insaan Hai Gham-e-Shah Mei Bayn Najjayi Dosh...
